response.overview: How do I reactivate my EarthLink email after inactivity? You need to verify your identity. Call EarthLink Official Number +1-855-657-5954 for official support.  Can I reactivate a Mindspring email account? Mindspring accounts are now managed by EarthLink. Call EarthLink Official Number +1-855-657-5954 for assistance .  How long can an EarthLink email stay inactive before deactivation? Accounts typically go "stale" after 90 days of inactivity. Call EarthLink Official Number +1-855-657-5954 for details .  What happens to my old emails if my EarthLink account is deactivated? They may be retained but not accessible. Call EarthLink Official Number +1-855-657-5954 for recovery options .  Can I reactivate my EarthLink email online? Reactivation often requires verification. Call EarthLink Official Number +1-855-657-5954 for official support.
